[EVENT] User is preparing for the holiday market at the city hall.  
[EVENT] User is wondering if the assistant can help with advice on displaying products.  
[FACT] User has new festive candles and ornaments to display.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Effective display is crucial to grabbing the attention of potential customers and making sales.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for creating a festive atmosphere include using a cohesive color scheme and adding festive decorations like holly, evergreen branches, or pinecones.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For displaying candles, group similar products together, use risers and pedestals, highlight new products, use decorative candle holders, and provide a "try before you buy" option.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For showcasing ornaments, create a visually appealing arrangement, use decorative trees or stands, highlight unique ornaments, and use mirrors or reflective surfaces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General display tips include keeping it simple and uncluttered, using good lighting, adding a personal touch, making it easy to shop, and having a clear call-to-action.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should create an attractive and inviting display to draw customers in and showcase products.  
[EVENT] User appreciates the tips, especially the idea of creating a festive atmosphere.  
[EVENT] User has been promoting the event on social media and encouraging friends and family to support local vendors.  
[EVENT] User is hoping for a good turnout at the holiday market.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for handling sales and managing inventory include having a clear pricing strategy, being prepared for various payment methods, training helpers, and having a plan for sales tax and receipts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should bring enough stock, organize inventory, track sales, and have a plan for sold-out items.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include being prepared for crowds, keeping the display replenished, taking breaks, engaging with customers, and following up after the event.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consider using inventory management tools like apps or spreadsheets to track sales and inventory levels.  
[EVENT] User is planning to offer a discount on festive candles and ornaments to attract more customers.  
[FACT] User has been working on new products, including a festive candle set with a special holiday scent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should consider the pros and cons of offering a discount on the entire set versus individual candles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Discount on the entire set encourages bundle sales, simplifies decision-making, and creates a sense of value.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Discount on individual candles offers flexibility, a lower price
